assistant.skills.shipped.pickUp.defaultMessage: Continue earlier work from its handover, checking it against the current state. Use when asked to continue, resume or pick up previous work, or to read a handover. Not for every new session.
assistant.skills.shipped.pickUp.description: What a skill that ships with Hive (pick-up) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab.

assistant.skills.shipped.reviewAgentWork.defaultMessage: Review another agent's work (a card in Review, a branch, commits or uncommitted changes) and report findings without changing it. Use when asked to review, check or verify work.
assistant.skills.shipped.reviewAgentWork.description: What a skill that ships with Hive (review-agent-work) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. Review is a column of the task board: use its name as the board shows it.

assistant.skills.shipped.runLanes.defaultMessage: Run a team as the Hive Assistant: builder and reviewer lanes on card loops, planned by files, briefed and watched to their end. Use when there are three or more agents, builder and reviewer pairs or worktree agents, when asked for lanes, or woken about one.
assistant.skills.shipped.runLanes.description: What a skill that ships with Hive (run-lanes) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. A lane is a builder and a reviewer taking cards in turn (a card loop): use the words Hive uses for them.

assistant.skills.shipped.splitWork.defaultMessage: Plan whether and how to divide a task between agents without conflicts, and save the plan. Use when asked how to split work between agents, to parallelise it, or to run several agents on it. Plans only: starting agents is separate.
assistant.skills.shipped.splitWork.description: What a skill that ships with Hive (split-work) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab.

assistant.skills.shipped.triageReport.defaultMessage: Turn a reported problem into a card with evidence as the Hive Assistant: cause first, then duplicates. Use when the user reports a problem.
assistant.skills.shipped.triageReport.description: What a skill that ships with Hive (triage-report) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. Keep Hive Assistant as Hive names it.

assistant.skills.shipped.tuneSettings.defaultMessage: Explain and suggest Hive's settings as the Hive Assistant; change one only when the user agrees. Use when asked what a setting does or how to make Hive behave differently, or when one would fix what you see.
assistant.skills.shipped.tuneSettings.description: What a skill that ships with Hive (tune-settings) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab.

assistant.skills.shipped.useHiveApi.defaultMessage: Call Hive's local HTTP API from a script or tool, or debug a hive tool against it. Use only when automating Hive over HTTP: for ordinary board, notes and handover work the hive tools are enough.
assistant.skills.shipped.useHiveApi.description: What a skill that ships with Hive (use-hive-api) is for: under its name in the Skills view and a project's Skills tab. Keep HTTP and API; hive tools are the tools Hive gives agents (hive_…), keep hive in lower case.

assistant.skills.shipped.workOnCard.defaultMessage: Carry a card from Hive's task board through its work, from Doing to Review with a summary. assistant.skills.shipped.workspaceNote.defaultMessage: Record a lasting decision, convention or gotcha in the workspace's shared notes. Use when asked to remember or document something for later, or when other agents will need what you learned. Not for work in progress.
